title: Projects
text:
AI Engineering Portfolio
19 production-grade AI systems demonstrating real-world engineering. Each project is fully runnable end-to-end. → View all projects on GitHub

01 — Production RAG with Citations
PDF Q&A API that returns answers with page-number citations. Implements hybrid search (dense vectors + BM25), cross-encoder reranking, and a LangGraph pipeline. Built for production: chunking, embedding caching, and SQLite-vec for zero-dependency vector storage.

LangGraph SQLite-vec sentence-transformers FastAPI BM25



02 — Cost-Optimized Model Router
Routes every query to the cheapest model that can handle it — Haiku for simple questions, Sonnet for medium, Opus for complex reasoning. Tracks cost per request in SQLite and exposes real-time Prometheus metrics. Saves up to 10× on API costs.

FastAPI Prometheus Anthropic SDK SQLite



03 — Multi-Agent Research System
A CrewAI pipeline where a Researcher, Writer, and Fact-Checker collaborate on research reports. The Fact-Checker marks uncertain claims with [UNCERTAIN] markers and pauses for human approval before finalisation. Every agent action is written to a tamper-evident JSONL audit trail.

CrewAI Anthropic SDK Audit Trail



04 — Automated Eval Harness
Runs 20+ golden Q&A test cases against a RAG system before every deploy. Uses DeepEval for answer relevancy and hallucination scoring. Blocks CI/CD pipelines if quality drops below threshold. Tracks eval scores over time to surface regressions.

DeepEval RAGAS pytest LangSmith



05 — Real-Time Observability Dashboard
Full-stack AI observability: distributed tracing with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus metrics (request rate, latency p50/p95/p99, cost per hour, error rate), and a pre-built Grafana dashboard that loads automatically. Essential for operating AI in production.

OpenTelemetry Prometheus Grafana Jaeger FastAPI



06 — Security Guardrail Middleware
FastAPI middleware that chains: prompt injection detection (regex + confidence scoring), PII redaction with Microsoft Presidio, output filtering for secrets and toxic content, and per-IP rate limiting. All blocked requests are logged to a security audit file.

Presidio slowapi FastAPI Anthropic SDK



07 — Local-First Development Environment
Zero API cost RAG system that mirrors the production architecture but runs 100% offline. Ollama handles local LLM inference, LanceDB provides embedded vector storage, and sentence-transformers generate embeddings locally. Perfect for development and testing.

Ollama LanceDB FastAPI sentence-transformers



08 — Streaming Copilot UI
Real-time token streaming chat UI built with Next.js 14 App Router and Vercel AI SDK. Tokens stream to the browser as they are generated. Includes optimistic UI updates, animated loading indicators, graceful error recovery, and a clean dark theme.

Next.js 14 Vercel AI SDK TypeScript Tailwind CSS



09 — Fine-Tuning Pipeline with LoRA
End-to-end instruction-tuning pipeline: dataset preparation in Alpaca format → LoRA fine-tuning with PEFT → evaluation with ROUGE-L before and after → catastrophic forgetting detection. Uses facebook/opt-125m for fast CPU-runnable demos; swap in any larger model.

PEFT TRL Hugging Face LoRA Transformers



10 — Multi-Tenant SaaS Agent
Production-ready multi-tenant AI agent with JWT authentication, strict row-level tenant data isolation, per-tenant rate limiting (free: 10 req/min, pro: 100 req/min), usage tracking with cost accounting, and an immutable audit log.

FastAPI SQLAlchemy JWT Stripe LangGraph



11 — CI/CD for AI Systems
Complete GitHub Actions pipeline: lint → unit tests → golden eval suite (blocks merge if score < 90%) → security scan. CD pipeline: Docker build → ArgoCD canary deploy (10% traffic) → smoke tests → promote or auto-rollback. Kubernetes manifests + feature flags included.

GitHub Actions ArgoCD Kubernetes Docker



12 — Vector Database at Scale
Qdrant-powered vector search service with hybrid retrieval (dense + Reciprocal Rank Fusion), Redis embedding cache (24h TTL, keyed by content hash), metadata filtering, index optimisation, and a QPS benchmark at k=1, 5, 10, 50.

Qdrant Redis sentence-transformers FastAPI



13 — Agent Memory System
Multi-layer persistent memory: Redis short-term buffer (last 10 turns, 1h TTL), Qdrant long-term fact storage (semantic recall across sessions), and automatic context compression with Claude Haiku when conversation history grows. Facts extracted and stored after every turn.

Redis Qdrant Anthropic SDK FastAPI



14 — Production Inference Server
vLLM load-balanced proxy with automatic health checking (every 10s), least-queue-depth routing across two instances, Prometheus metrics (TTFT, throughput, errors), and automatic failover. Kubernetes deployment manifests and HPA configuration included.

vLLM FastAPI Prometheus Kubernetes



15 — Human-in-the-Loop Workflow
AI task planner with uncertainty detection that automatically pauses on irreversible or sensitive actions for human review. Includes a WebSocket-powered approval UI, SQLite approval store, full audit trail, and resume-on-approval logic.

LangGraph FastAPI WebSocket SQLite



16 — Agentic Automation Pipeline
Async AI job queue: webhook receiver (with HMAC signature validation), Redis-based idempotency deduplication, Celery tasks with exponential backoff retries (30s → 60s → 120s), and Flower monitoring UI. Handles GitHub PR webhooks out of the box.

FastAPI Celery Redis Anthropic SDK Flower



17 — Domain-Specific Legal AI Benchmark
Evaluation suite for AI systems on South African legal tasks: contract clause extraction, legal Q&A, and risk assessment. Scores models on ROUGE-L and semantic similarity. Includes a public leaderboard, model adapter interface, and pytest-based test suite.

DeepEval ROUGE sentence-transformers pytest



18 — Sunflower Multilingual Translation API
Translation and conversational AI across 31 Ugandan languages powered by Sunbird’s Sunflower-14B-W8A8. Supports auto-detection of input language, batch translation, streaming chat, and a clean OpenAI-compatible interface backed by vLLM.

Sunflower-14B vLLM FastAPI African Languages



19 — Uganda Community Health Bot
A community health chatbot answering questions about malaria, maternal health, child nutrition, and HIV in Luganda, Acholi, Ateso, Runyankole, and other Ugandan languages — using Sunbird Sunflower-14B. Includes emergency detection with instant local responses and WhatsApp integration via Twilio.

Sunflower-14B FastAPI Twilio WhatsApp African Languages

title: Projects
text:
Research & Earlier Projects

Text Classification Using Embeddings for Luganda
Topic classifier for the Luganda text corpus using Cohere embedding representations and an SVM with hyper-parameter search. Demonstrates full NLP pipeline development for a low-resource Bantu language.

Python SVM Cohere API Scikit-learn Low-resource NLP



Water Quality Data Visualisation — Kampala
Interactive visualisation of water quality metrics across Kampala Central Division, surfacing spatial patterns in sanitation data to support public health analysis and policy.

R Data Visualisation Geospatial Analysis Public Health



Fine-Tune Alpaca for Any Language
Fine-tuned the Alpaca instruction-following LLM for multilingual language translation and topic classification, exploring parameter-efficient adaptation for low-resource language settings.

Python LLaMA / Alpaca Instruction Tuning Fine-tuning Multilingual NLP



Chest Opacity Detection from Ultrasound Images
Deep learning pipeline for detecting chest opacities in ultrasound images — a low-cost, non-ionising alternative to CT scanning, aimed at resource-constrained clinical settings in LMICs.

Python PyTorch Deep Learning Medical Imaging Computer Vision

title: Eric Peter Wairagala
text:
Research Engineer, Lelapa AI · NLP Researcher · African Language AI
      I build machine learning systems that work for African language speakers — a billion people largely excluded from the benefits of modern AI. At Lelapa AI, I develop resource-efficient NLP for the Vulavula platform: multilingual speech recognition, machine translation with code-switching support, and low-resource language models deployed at enterprise scale.
      My research runs in parallel: investigating gender bias in machine translation, named entity recognition for low-resource languages, and explainable AI for African NLP. I hold an MSc in Computer Science (2025) from Makerere University and am actively seeking a PhD position to push the foundations of this work further.
